title: Right On Q: Recovering Reasoning under Quantization via Self-Generated Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2610.29378v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) aims to recover reasoning capabilities in low-bit large language models (LLMs). Existing recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the original full-precision model on fixed response sequences. However, the resulting low-bit quantized models still struggle on long-horizon reasoning tasks and often fail to terminate within a token budget that suffices for the full-precision model. We identify two challenges in closing this gap. First, fixed-response supervision leaves a mismatch between training prefixes and those encountered during student generation, and this trajectory divergence grows as responses lengthen. Second, on its own prefixes, the student underpredicts some next-token candidates and overpredicts others, and this distributional misalignment becomes more frequent at high-entropy prefixes. translated_title: Right On Q：通过自生成轨迹恢复量化模型的推理能力
translated_abstract: 量化感知训练（QAT）旨在恢复低比特大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。现有方法通常利用原始的全精度模型在固定的响应序列上对量化学生模型进行监督。然而，由此得到的低比特量化模型在长程推理任务上仍然表现不佳，并且常常无法在足以满足全精度模型的token预算内正常终止。我们识别出了缩小这一差距的两个挑战：第一，固定响应监督导致训练前缀与学生模型实际生成时遇到的前缀之间存在不匹配，且随着响应变长，这种轨迹分歧会不断增大；第二，在学生模型自身的前缀上，它会对某些下一个token候选词预测不足，而对另一些候选词预测过度，这种分布失配在高熵前缀处出现得更加频繁。我们提出了OnQ，一个低比特恢复流水线，它结合了在策略蒸馏与候选（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出OnQ流水线，通过在策略蒸馏利用学生模型自生成的轨迹进行训练，解决了固定响应监督导致的训练与生成前缀不匹配及高熵处分布失配问题，从而恢复低比特量化大模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: OnQ recovers reasoning in low-bit quantized LLMs via on-policy distillation on self-generated trajectories, addressing trajectory divergence and distributional misalignment that arise from fixed-response supervision.
